title: Bhaiya Kyun Nahi
body:
pooch rahi hai karbobala ke raston se bemaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rulaate hai mujhko yasrab ke dar o deewar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se ojhal nahi hota chehra akbar ka
dhoondti rehti hoon khwabon mein sehra akbar ka
toot ke roz bikhar jaate hai aansuon ke haar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se falak par chand nazar aaya hai moharam ka
lagta hai mujhko arsh bhi jaise farsh ho matam ka
chand ke peeche jaise chipi ho barchi aur talwaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua ay maalik mera baabul khair se ho
ghayr na le sehrayi darinde duldul khair se ho
ache nahi haalat bhi shayad kufe ke us paar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hui aakhir mujhse khata maloom to ho mujhko
paayi hai kyun furqat ki saza maloom to ho mujhko
rooth gaya majboor behen se kyun beeran ka pyaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat bheja aur qasid se sandes bhi keh laaya
phir bhi mujh birhan ka kisi ko dhyaan nahi aaya
bhool gaya pardes mein jaa kar mujhko mera pariwar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haar gayi mai kismat ki tehreerein jeet gayi
raasta takte takte do do eidein beet gayi
ho na saka hamshakle nabi ke chehre ka deedar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun kitna kathin hai hijr ka gham bhaiya
choomti rehti hoon mai tere nakshe qadam bhaiya
darr hai mit jaaye na kahin in qadmon ke aasaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere maalik mere pardesi kunbe ki khair
behno ke maaon ke phupiyon ke parde ki khair
khwaab mein maine dekhe hai kuch pathar aur bazaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hoon naiza naiza chadar chadar khoon
basti basti sehra sehra pathar pathar khoon
sheeshe mein jo khaak thi wo bhi hogayi khoon ki dhaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise kisi barchi ki chuban mehsoos ho seene mein
rone lagti hai ek bibi ab bhi madine mein
sunte hi aamir ki zaban se nayyar ke ash'aar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
